name: nft-tracker-site-vendor
description: Собирает минимальный бандл анимаций (Anime.js + Motion) в assets/js/vendor.js

scripts.build: esbuild entry.mjs --bundle --minify --format=iife --target=es2019 --legal-comments=none --banner:js="/*! vendor bundle: animejs@4.5.0 (MIT, Julian Garnier) + motion@14.0.0 (MIT, Matt Perry). See vendor.LICENSE.txt */" --outfile=../../assets/js/vendor.js
